title: Overflowing storm drain causing street flooding
description: The storm drain outside Sunrise Apartments is blocked and overflows during light rain. Water reaches the main road and disrupts traffic.

title: Noise from late-night construction at downtown mall
description: Construction work at the downtown mall continues after midnight with heavy machinery and loud drilling. Residents cannot sleep.

title: Unsafe pedestrian crossing missing zebra lines
description: The pedestrian crossing in front of City Library has faded zebra lines and no pedestrian signal. People cross unsafely every day.

title: Broken public water fountain leaking continuously
description: The public water fountain at Green Park is leaking and wasting water. It also creates a slippery area that may cause falls.

title: Unauthorized billboard blocking traffic sign
description: An unauthorized billboard has been placed on the median near R.K. Highway and is blocking the traffic sign. Drivers are confused.

title: Street vendors obstructing footpath near school
description: Street vendors have occupied the sidewalk in front of Bright Future School. Parents and children must walk on the road.

title: Public park fountain lights not working
description: The decorative lights at the park fountain are broken and the area is dark after sunset. Families are avoiding the park at night.

title: Garbage collection missed for two weeks in Sector 9
description: Trash bins in Sector 9 were not emptied for 14 days. The area smells bad and rodents are visible.

title: Public bus shelter damaged with missing roof
description: The bus shelter at Oak Avenue stop has a damaged roof and no seating. Commuters have no shelter during rain.

title: Illegal parking blocking emergency lane
description: Several cars are parked in the emergency lane outside City Hospital
